author: Ankit
problem: Read a string S of lowercase letters and '.' that contains at least one '.' and doesn't end with '.'. Print the part after the last '.'.
bug_description: The scan starts at i = 0, and S[-0] is S[0], so a string starting with '.' prints everything after its first character.

comments.accurate: Prints the text after the last dot
comments.wrong_behavior: A leading dot marks a hidden-file name, so everything after it is printed
comments.wrong_location: Backward scan verified; check the slice when the dot is the second-to-last character
